post.title: What a non-compete can and can't stop (state rules vary)
post.ig:
18% of US workers have a non-compete (studies reviewed by GAO, 2023). What can it actually stop?
It can't stop you from quitting. Where allowed, it can limit work for a rival, for a set time, in a set area.
The FTC's 2024 ban was set aside by a court in Aug 2024; the FTC dropped its appeals in Sept 2025 and removed the rule in Feb 2026.
California, Minnesota, North Dakota, Oklahoma and Wyoming ban most. Illinois' pay floor rose to $80,000 on Jan 1, 2027 (from $75,000). Washington's near-total ban starts June 30, 2027.
Sources: GAO, FTC, Federal Register, Illinois General Assembly, Washington L&I.
Rules vary by state; check yours. News and education, not financial or legal advice.
